# REDZ.UI — the documentation in full

# Getting started

REDZ.UI is two stylesheets and a set of small scripts on the browser platform. Nothing is built where it is used: link the files, write Bootstrap-like markup, and the browser does the rest.

## Get it

Every release is an immutable release on GitHub: once it is out, neither its tag nor its files can change. `redz-ui-0.1.0.zip` holds the library's files and its passport, `redz-ui.json` — the version, the floor, the stylesheets a bundle joins in their order, the modules, every class, token, command and text key, and the sha256 of every file. `checks.zip` beside it is the sheet of the probes the release passed in every engine.

```js
gh release download v0.1.0 --repo redz-tech/REDZ.UI --pattern 'redz-ui-*.zip'
gh release verify-asset v0.1.0 redz-ui-0.1.0.zip --repo redz-tech/REDZ.UI
```

Or from jsDelivr, which serves a release by its tag:

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/redz-tech/REDZ.UI@v0.1.0/css/index.css">
```

## Include it

The stylesheet, the icons and the scripts, with the page's own words for the few things the library says — every word comes from the page, the library has none of its own.

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="redz-ui/css/index.css">
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="redz-ui/css/icons.css">
  <script type="module" src="redz-ui/js/index.js"></script>
  <script type="application/json" id="redz-ui-text">{"close": "Close", "confirm.ok": "OK", "confirm.cancel": "Cancel", "busy": "Loading…"}</script>
</head>
```

- `css/index.css` pulls in the layers, the tokens, the components and the utilities, 19 KB gzipped. A consumer that bundles may join its files in that order — the passport lists them.
- `css/icons.css` is apart: one mask per Bootstrap Icons file, used only by name.
- `js/index.js` is an ES module; it loads the behaviors and sets `REDZ.ui` for calls from code.

## How it reads

- A component, its variant, its size and its parts are one class each: `btn btn-primary btn-sm`, `card-header` — Bootstrap 5's names, and Bootstrap 6's where it moved onto the platform: `dialog`, `drawer`, `menu`.
- A utility is `property-value`: `d-flex`, `text-muted`. The number is the value — `p-16` is 16 px, `w-50` is 50 %.
- A condition is a prefix: `md:cols-2`, `print:d-none`. A width prefix measures the region the element sits in — a column, a card, a dialog — not the window.
- A state is an HTML attribute: `aria-pressed`, `aria-current`, `disabled`, `[open]`. A button opens a menu or a dialog with the browser's own command: `commandfor` + `command`.
- Tokens are `--redz-` plus the same words: `--redz-text-muted`, `--redz-space-16`.

## Theme and direction

Without an attribute the page follows the system's light or dark. `data-theme="light"` or `data-theme="dark"` on `<html>` fixes one — set it on the server, so the page never flashes. Right to left is `dir="rtl"`: one stylesheet serves both directions, by logical properties, and icons that point mirror with `flip-rtl`.

```html
<html lang="ar" dir="rtl" data-theme="dark">
```

## From script

Menus, tabs, dialogs and their keys need no call: the library listens on the document. Three calls are for code:

| Call | Does |
| --- | --- |
| `REDZ.ui.toast({title, text, tone, action, persistent})` | Shows a notice; answers a function that closes it. [Toasts](toast.md) |
| `await REDZ.ui.confirm({title, text, ok, cancel, tone})` | Asks a question in a dialog; answers `true` or `false`. [Dialogs](dialog.md) |
| `await REDZ.ui.busy(element, promise)` | Marks a button or a region busy until the promise settles. [Busy](busy.md) |

## Browsers

Bootstrap 6's floor: Chrome and Edge 130+, Firefox 132+, Safari 18+ on macOS and iOS. What must work rests on features of the floor; invoker commands and anchor positioning are written in their final form, and a small script stands in below them. Every page of these docs is checked in real engines at the floor and above — [the checks](https://redz-tech.github.io/REDZ.UI/checks/).

## From Bootstrap 5.3

| Bootstrap 5.3 | REDZ.UI | Change | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `data-bs-theme` | `data-theme` | rename | light or dark on <html> |

# Layout

The parent sets the grid, the number is the count, and a width prefix measures the region the element is in. Stacks for a column or a row of items, gaps between them, no margins on components.

## Grids

`grid` on the parent, `cols-N` for N equal columns, `gap-*` between them. A width prefix adds columns as the region grows: `grid md:cols-2` is one column until the region is 768 px wide. Every example on these pages is a region of its own — resize the window and watch the examples, not the window.

```html
<div class="grid sm:cols-2 lg:cols-4 gap-16">
	<div class="card"><div class="card-body">One</div></div>
	<div class="card"><div class="card-body">Two</div></div>
	<div class="card"><div class="card-body">Three</div></div>
	<div class="card"><div class="card-body">Four</div></div>
</div>
```

### Spans on a 12-column grid

A child's exception: `span-N` or `span-full`, with a prefix where it changes.

```html
<div class="grid md:cols-12 gap-16">
	<div class="card md:span-8"><div class="card-body">The main column — <code>md:span-8</code></div></div>
	<div class="card md:span-4"><div class="card-body">The side — <code>md:span-4</code></div></div>
</div>
```

### As many as fit

`cols-min-240`: as many columns as fit, none narrower than 240 px.

```html
<div class="grid cols-min-160 gap-12">
	<div class="card"><div class="card-body">lagoon.example</div></div>
	<div class="card"><div class="card-body">villas.lagoon.example</div></div>
	<div class="card"><div class="card-body">angthong.example</div></div>
</div>
```

## Stacks

`vstack` is a column of items, `hstack` a row of them centered on one line; `gap-*` spaces them and `ms-auto` pushes the rest to the end.

```html
<div class="hstack gap-8">
	<span class="badge">Draft</span>
	<span class="text-muted">Edited 2 hours ago</span>
	<button class="btn btn-sm ms-auto" type="button">Preview</button>
	<button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary" type="button">Publish</button>
</div>
```

## Regions and breakpoints

Regions are the shell's main and side columns, cards, dialogs, drawers, and any block with the class `region`. A page without the shell marks its own `region`; the root is never one.

| Prefix | The region is at least |
| --- | --- |
| `sm:` | 576 px |
| `md:` | 768 px |
| `lg:` | 1024 px |
| `xl:` | 1280 px |
| `2xl:` | 1536 px |
| `print:` | on paper |

- A region inside a flex row needs a width — `flex-grow-1` or a grid track: its size cannot come from its content.
- A card in the 8-of-12 column at 1440 px is about 740 px wide: `sm:` inside it, not `md:`.

## From Bootstrap 5.3

| Bootstrap 5.3 | REDZ.UI | Change | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `col` | — | grid | equal columns come from the parent's cols-N; the child needs no class |
| `col-1` | `span-1` | grid | N of 12: the parent is grid cols-12 (or md:cols-12) |
| `col-10` | `span-10` | grid | N of 12: the parent is grid cols-12 (or md:cols-12) |

| `col-4` | `span-4` | grid | N of 12: the parent is grid cols-12 (or md:cols-12) |
| `col-5` | `span-5` | grid | N of 12: the parent is grid cols-12 (or md:cols-12) |

| `col-8` | `span-8` | grid | N of 12: the parent is grid cols-12 (or md:cols-12) |
| `col-9` | `span-9` | grid | N of 12: the parent is grid cols-12 (or md:cols-12) |
| `col-auto` | — | review | a column as wide as its content: hstack, or grid-template-columns in the module's CSS |
| `container` | — | review | the shell's app-main, or a region with max-w-* and mx-auto |

| `g-0` | `gap-0` | grid | on the grid parent |

| `g-2` | `gap-8` | grid | on the grid parent |
| `g-3` | `gap-16` | grid | on the grid parent |
| `g-4` | `gap-24` | grid | on the grid parent |
| `g-5` | `gap-48` | grid | on the grid parent |
| `gx-0` | `column-gap-0` | grid | on the grid parent |
| `gx-1` | `column-gap-4` | grid | on the grid parent |
| `gx-2` | `column-gap-8` | grid | on the grid parent |
| `gx-3` | `column-gap-16` | grid | on the grid parent |
| `gx-4` | `column-gap-24` | grid | on the grid parent |
| `gx-5` | `column-gap-48` | grid | on the grid parent |
| `gy-0` | `row-gap-0` | grid | on the grid parent |
| `gy-1` | `row-gap-4` | grid | on the grid parent |
| `gy-2` | `row-gap-8` | grid | on the grid parent |
| `gy-3` | `row-gap-16` | grid | on the grid parent |
| `gy-4` | `row-gap-24` | grid | on the grid parent |
| `gy-5` | `row-gap-48` | grid | on the grid parent |
| `offset-1` | — | review | no offsets: a span with an empty track before it |
| `offset-10` | — | review | no offsets: a span with an empty track before it |
| `offset-11` | — | review | no offsets: a span with an empty track before it |
| `offset-2` | — | review | no offsets: a span with an empty track before it |
| `offset-3` | — | review | no offsets: a span with an empty track before it |
| `offset-4` | — | review | no offsets: a span with an empty track before it |
| `offset-5` | — | review | no offsets: a span with an empty track before it |
| `offset-6` | — | review | no offsets: a span with an empty track before it |
| `offset-7` | — | review | no offsets: a span with an empty track before it |
| `offset-8` | — | review | no offsets: a span with an empty track before it |
| `offset-9` | — | review | no offsets: a span with an empty track before it |
| `row` | `grid` | grid | on the parent, with cols-N for equal columns or cols-12 for spans; no gutters to undo |
| `row-cols-1` | `cols-1` | grid | on the same parent |
| `row-cols-2` | `cols-2` | grid | on the same parent |
| `row-cols-3` | `cols-3` | grid | on the same parent |
| `row-cols-4` | `cols-4` | grid | on the same parent |
| `row-cols-5` | `cols-5` | grid | on the same parent |
| `row-cols-6` | `cols-6` | grid | on the same parent |
| `row-cols-auto` | — | review | items as wide as their content: hstack flex-wrap |

# Utilities

Single-purpose classes with Bootstrap 5's names, where the number is the value: `p-16`, `gap-8`, `fs-14`, `rounded-8`, `w-50`. Written once from a vocabulary file and committed — nothing is generated where they are used.

## Scales

- Space, in px: 0 2 4 8 12 16 20 24 32 40 48 64 — for `m`, `p` and `gap` with their sides: `mt` `mb` `ms` `me` `mx` `my`, the same for `p`. `ms` and `me` are the start and the end of the line, so they turn right to left.
- Font size: 12 14 16 18 20 24 32; line height: 16 20 24 28; radius: 0 4 6 8 12 16 and `rounded-full`.
- Width prefixes come on placement and spacing — display, flex, grid, gaps, order, text alignment, margins and paddings: `md:d-none`, `lg:p-24`.

## Every utility

| Class | Declarations | Width prefixes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `d-none` | `display: none;` | yes |
| `d-inline` | `display: inline;` | yes |

## From Bootstrap 5.3

| Bootstrap 5.3 | REDZ.UI | Change | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bg-black` | — | review | bg-body, bg-page, bg-raised or a tone |
| `bg-body-secondary` | `bg-page` | rename |  |
| `bg-body-tertiary` | `bg-raised` | rename |  |
| `bg-dark` | — | review | bg-body, bg-page, bg-raised or a tone |
| `bg-dark-subtle` | — | review | bg-page, or a tone's -subtle |
| `bg-gradient` | — | remove | no gradients |
| `bg-light` | — | review | bg-body, bg-page, bg-raised or a tone |
| `bg-light-subtle` | — | review | bg-page, or a tone's -subtle |
| `bg-opacity-10` | — | missing |  |
| `bg-opacity-100` | — | missing |  |
| `bg-opacity-25` | — | missing |  |
| `bg-opacity-50` | — | missing |  |
| `bg-opacity-75` | — | missing |  |
| `bg-white` | — | review | bg-body, bg-page, bg-raised or a tone |

# Tokens

The custom properties on `:root` that the components read: colors by role in pairs that pass WCAG AA in both themes, spacing, type, radii, shadows and motion. A theme changes tokens, never component rules.

## How they are made

- Colors by role: `--redz-text`, `-muted`, `-faint`; `--redz-bg-page`, `--redz-bg`, `-raised`, `-hover`; a tone, its `-subtle` fill and its `-contrast` text for primary, secondary, success, danger, warning and info.
- Text is at least 4.5:1 on its background, the borders of fields and the focus ring 3:1, in the light and the dark theme — computed in OKLCH and written as checked hex.
- A component declares a few properties of its own on its root and never on rows or items: hundreds of properties on small elements slow every style recalculation.

## Every token, light theme

| Token | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `--redz-bg` | `light-dark(#ffffff, #161719)` |
| `--redz-bg-raised` | `light-dark(#ffffff, #212224)` |
| `--redz-bg-page` | `light-dark(#f5f6f8, #0f0f11)` |
| `--redz-bg-hover` | `light-dark(#eff0f2, #252629)` |
| `--redz-text` | `light-dark(#191a1d, #eeeef0)` |
| `--redz-text-muted` | `light-dark(#595b5f, #acaeb2)` |
| `--redz-text-faint` | `light-dark(#7e8085, #7f8084)` |
| `--redz-border` | `light-dark(#e5e6e8, #2d2e30)` |
| `--redz-border-strong` | `light-dark(#7e8085, #7f8084)` |
| `--redz-primary` | `light-dark(#006cc9, #64a9f3)` |
| `--redz-primary-subtle` | `light-dark(#e5f2ff, #1d3249)` |
| `--redz-primary-contrast` | `light-dark(#ffffff, #000000)` |
| `--redz-secondary` | `light-dark(#595b5f, #acaeb2)` |
| `--redz-secondary-subtle` | `light-dark(#eff0f2, #252629)` |
| `--redz-secondary-contrast` | `light-dark(#ffffff, #000000)` |
| `--redz-success` | `light-dark(#1d7d3e, #66be7b)` |

# Icons

Bootstrap Icons 1.13.2 under their own class names — `<i class="bi bi-pencil">` — each a CSS mask over its own SVG file: the color of the text around it, no font, no script, no build.

## Examples

An icon takes the size of the text and its color: a utility or the parent sets both.

```html
<i class="bi bi-pencil" aria-hidden="true"></i>
<i class="bi bi-trash3 text-danger" aria-hidden="true"></i>
<i class="bi bi-check-circle-fill text-success fs-20" aria-hidden="true"></i>
<i class="bi bi-stars text-primary fs-24" aria-hidden="true"></i>
<i class="bi bi-chevron-right flip-rtl" aria-hidden="true"></i>
<i class="bi bi-arrow-left flip-rtl" aria-hidden="true"></i>
```

The names are Bootstrap Icons' own — look one up at [icons.getbootstrap.com](https://icons.getbootstrap.com/). A name the set does not have paints a filled square, and the checks flag it.

## Accessibility

- An icon beside words is `aria-hidden="true"`. An icon alone takes its meaning from its parent: the button's `aria-label`, or hidden words.
- Icons that point — chevrons, arrows, back and next — mirror right to left with `flip-rtl`; a check, a clock, a search glass, media controls do not.
- Icons keep the forced color of their parent and print in their color.

## From Bootstrap 5.3

| Bootstrap 5.3 | REDZ.UI | Change | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `icon-link` | — | review | a link with its icon: hstack gap-4 |
| `icon-link-hover` | — | review | a link with its icon: hstack gap-4 |

# From Bootstrap 5.3

Most of Bootstrap 5's names stay. What changes is the spacing numbers, the grid, the breakpoints, states and triggers, and the three components Bootstrap 6 renamed. The two libraries are never on one page: a project switches its stylesheet at once.

## What changes

- **Spacing:** the number is the pixels. `p-3` becomes `p-16`, `mb-2` `mb-8`, `gap-4` `gap-24` — and `p-4` exists in both with another size: Bootstrap's 24 px, REDZ.UI's 4 px. Never rename by chained replacements; rewrite each file once.
- **Grid:** `row` and `col-md-6` become the parent's `grid md:cols-2`; a column's own width is `span-N`.
- **Breakpoints:** the infix becomes a prefix — `d-md-none` is `md:d-none` — and it measures the region, not the window.
- **States:** classes become attributes — `.active` is `aria-current`, `aria-selected` or `aria-pressed`; `.disabled` is `disabled` or `aria-disabled`; `.is-invalid` is `aria-invalid="true"`.
- **Triggers:** `data-bs-toggle` becomes the browser's commands — `commandfor` + `command="show-modal"`, `"close"` or `"toggle-popover"`; `bootstrap.Modal` becomes `dialog.showModal()`.
- **Renamed:** modal → `dialog` on a `<dialog>`, dropdown → `menu` on a popover, offcanvas → `drawer`.
- **Icons:** Bootstrap Icons keep their classes; swap the font's stylesheet for `css/icons.css`.

## With an agent

The skill `redz-ui-from-bootstrap-5` moves a project file by file: `scripts/scan.sh` finds every Bootstrap class, attribute and call with its replacement and checks every class against the vocabulary; the agent rewrites the whole file in one pass, scans it again until nothing is left, and compares the screens before and after. Install it with `npx skills add redz-tech/REDZ.UI`.

## The map

Every class of Bootstrap 5.3.8 that changes, with what it becomes; a class not listed keeps its name, and a breakpoint form follows its class — `mb-md-3` is `md:mb-16`. The full map, every class and form, is the skill's `assets/map.tsv`.

| `translate-middle` | — | missing | center by grid or flex |
| `translate-middle-x` | — | missing | center by grid or flex |
| `translate-middle-y` | — | missing | center by grid or flex |
| `valid-feedback` | — | remove | fields have no success state |
| `valid-tooltip` | — | remove | fields have no success state |

| `data-bs-toggle="modal"` | `commandfor="ID" command="show-modal"` | trigger | on the button; the dialog is a <dialog id="ID"> |
| `data-bs-toggle="offcanvas"` | `commandfor="ID" command="show-modal"` | trigger | the drawer is a <dialog id="ID"> |

# Buttons

A button runs an action; a link drawn as a button goes somewhere. One class, `btn`, then a tone, a size or an icon when the button needs one.

## Examples

The plain `btn` is neutral. `btn-primary` marks the one main action of a screen; the other tones say what an action does.

```html
<button class="btn btn-primary" type="button">Save</button>
<button class="btn" type="button">Cancel</button>
<button class="btn btn-secondary" type="button">Duplicate</button>
<button class="btn btn-success" type="button">Publish</button>
<button class="btn btn-danger" type="button">Delete</button>
<button class="btn btn-warning" type="button">Withdraw</button>
<button class="btn btn-info" type="button">Preview</button>
```

### Outline, subtle, text and link

Quieter forms of the same tones for secondary actions, rows and toolbars. `btn-text` has no fill until hovered; `btn-link` reads as a link and keeps a button's size.

```html
<button class="btn btn-outline-primary" type="button">Outline</button>
<button class="btn btn-outline-danger" type="button">Outline danger</button>
<button class="btn btn-subtle-primary" type="button">Subtle</button>
<button class="btn btn-subtle-danger" type="button">Subtle danger</button>
<button class="btn btn-text" type="button">Text</button>
<button class="btn btn-link" type="button">Link</button>
```

### Sizes

A size is a word: `btn-xs` 24 px, `btn-sm` 28 px, the default 32 px, `btn-lg` 40 px — the heights of every control of the same size.

```html
<button class="btn btn-primary btn-xs" type="button">Extra small</button>
<button class="btn btn-primary btn-sm" type="button">Small</button>
<button class="btn btn-primary" type="button">Default</button>
<button class="btn btn-primary btn-lg" type="button">Large</button>
```

### Icons

An icon sits beside the words, or alone in a square `btn-icon` whose name is its `aria-label`. `btn-close` draws the close glyph by itself.

```html
<button class="btn" type="button"><i class="bi bi-plus-lg" aria-hidden="true"></i>New excursion</button>
<a class="btn" href="#btn-icons">Open the site<i class="bi bi-box-arrow-up-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></a>
<button class="btn btn-icon" type="button" aria-label="Edit"><i class="bi bi-pencil" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
<button class="btn btn-icon btn-text" type="button" aria-label="More actions"><i class="bi bi-three-dots" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
<button class="btn btn-icon btn-sm btn-subtle-danger" type="button" aria-label="Remove"><i class="bi bi-trash3" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
<button class="btn-close" type="button" aria-label="Close"></button>
```

### Groups and toolbars

`btn-group` joins buttons into one control — here a choice of view, each button pressed or not. `btn-toolbar` lays groups and buttons out in a wrapping row.

```html
<div class="btn-toolbar" role="group" aria-label="List view">
	<div class="btn-group" role="group" aria-label="Layout">
		<button class="btn" type="button" aria-pressed="true">List</button>
		<button class="btn" type="button" aria-pressed="false">Board</button>
		<button class="btn" type="button" aria-pressed="false">Calendar</button>
	</div>
	<div class="btn-group" role="group" aria-label="Export">
		<button class="btn" type="button">Export</button>
		<button class="btn btn-icon" type="button" aria-label="Export options"><i class="bi bi-chevron-down" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
	</div>
</div>
```

### Toggle and busy

A toggle carries `aria-pressed`. While its action runs, `REDZ.ui.busy(button, promise)` shows a spinner in the button and marks it `aria-disabled`: it keeps the focus and ignores clicks until the promise settles.

```html
<button class="btn" type="button" aria-pressed="false" data-docs-run="toggle"><i class="bi bi-pin-angle" aria-hidden="true"></i>Pin</button>
<button class="btn btn-primary" type="button" data-docs-run="busy-button">Save for 2 seconds</button>
```

## States

A state is the attribute accessibility needs anyway, on the button itself: no `active` or `disabled` classes. `aria-expanded` is set by the browser on a button that opens a menu or a dialog.

## Keyboard and accessibility

- `<button type="button">` for an action, `<a href>` for a place; `btn` draws both the same. Enter and Space press a button, Enter follows a link.
- A button with only an icon takes its name from `aria-label`; the icon is `aria-hidden="true"`.
- `disabled` takes a button out of the tab order and hides why. `aria-disabled="true"` keeps it focusable — so a tooltip can say why — and the library swallows its clicks.
- A button that opens a menu or a dialog uses the browser's command: `commandfor` + `command`, never `data-bs-toggle`.
- The focus ring is 2 px of `--redz-focus`, 3:1 against the page in both themes.

## Tokens

From [`css/components/btn.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/btn.css). It declares `--redz-btn-bg`, `--redz-btn-fg`, `--redz-btn-hover`, `--redz-btn-hover-fg` on its root, never on rows or items.

It reads the theme's `--redz-bg-hover`, `--redz-text`, `--redz-control-height`, `--redz-space-12`, `--redz-radius-8`, `--redz-primary`, `--redz-primary-contrast`, `--redz-secondary`, `--redz-secondary-contrast`, `--redz-success`, `--redz-success-contrast`, `--redz-danger`, `--redz-danger-contrast`, `--redz-warning`, `--redz-warning-contrast`, `--redz-info`, `--redz-info-contrast`, `--redz-primary-subtle`, `--redz-secondary-subtle`, `--redz-success-subtle`, `--redz-danger-subtle`, `--redz-warning-subtle`, `--redz-info-subtle`, `--redz-control-height-xs`, `--redz-radius-6`, `--redz-fs-12`, `--redz-control-height-sm`, `--redz-space-8`, `--redz-control-height-lg`, `--redz-space-16`, `--redz-fs-16`, `--redz-bg-page`, `--redz-text-faint`, `--redz-text-muted`, `--redz-motion`.

## From Bootstrap 5.3

| Bootstrap 5.3 | REDZ.UI | Change | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `btn-check` | — | review | a toggle is a btn with aria-pressed; a choice is radio inputs |
| `btn-close-white` | — | remove | the close glyph takes the text color |
| `btn-dark` | — | review | no light or dark buttons: btn or btn-text |
| `btn-group-vertical` | — | missing |  |
| `btn-light` | — | review | no light or dark buttons: btn or btn-text |
| `btn-outline-dark` | — | review | btn-outline-secondary |
| `btn-outline-light` | — | review | btn-outline-secondary |
| `data-bs-toggle="button"` | `aria-pressed` | review | switch aria-pressed in your click handler |

# Chips

A chip is a small rounded choice: a filter that is on or off, a saved view, an applied filter with its count and a way to remove it.

## Examples

A filter chip is a toggle button: `aria-pressed` says whether it is on. A chip that opens a menu is the menu's button.

```html
<button class="chip" type="button" aria-pressed="true"><i class="bi bi-eye" aria-hidden="true"></i>Published</button>
<button class="chip" type="button" aria-pressed="false"><i class="bi bi-pencil-square" aria-hidden="true"></i>Drafts</button>
<button class="chip" type="button" aria-pressed="false"><i class="bi bi-translate" aria-hidden="true"></i>Language: any</button>
<button class="chip" type="button" commandfor="chip-site-menu" command="toggle-popover" aria-haspopup="menu"><i class="bi bi-globe2" aria-hidden="true"></i>Site: all<i class="bi bi-chevron-down" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
<div id="chip-site-menu" class="menu menu-start" popover role="menu" aria-label="Site">
	<button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitemradio" aria-checked="true">All sites</button>
	<button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitemradio" aria-checked="false">lagoon.example</button>
	<button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitemradio" aria-checked="false">angthong.example</button>
</div>
```

### Saved views and applied filters

Links between saved views mark the current one with `aria-current="true"`. An applied filter is a group: its name, its count in `chip-count`, and a `chip-dismiss` button named after what it removes.

```html
<a class="chip" href="#chip-views" aria-current="true">All<span class="chip-count">28</span></a>
<a class="chip" href="#chip-views">Needs attention<span class="chip-count">3</span></a>
<a class="chip" href="#chip-views">Mine<span class="chip-count">11</span></a>
<span class="chip" role="group" aria-label="Filter: section Marine"><i class="bi bi-diagram-3" aria-hidden="true"></i>Section: Marine<span class="chip-count">9</span><button class="chip-dismiss" type="button" aria-label="Remove filter: section Marine"><i class="bi bi-x" aria-hidden="true"></i></button></span>
```

## States

## Keyboard and accessibility

- A filter chip is a `<button>` with `aria-pressed`; Space or Enter toggles it. Change the attribute when the filter changes — the look follows it.
- A saved view is a link; the current one carries `aria-current="true"`.
- An applied filter is `role="group"` named after the filter, and its dismiss button names what it removes — "Remove filter: section Marine", not "Remove".
- A count is part of the chip's name; say what it counts in the words around it when it is not obvious.

## Tokens

From [`css/components/chip.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/chip.css), which declares no custom property of its own.

It reads the theme's `--redz-control-height-sm`, `--redz-border`, `--redz-bg`, `--redz-text`, `--redz-fs-12`, `--redz-bg-hover`, `--redz-primary-subtle`, `--redz-primary`, `--redz-text-muted`.

# Menus

A menu is a short list of actions or choices that opens from a button: the browser's popover, placed beside the button by CSS anchor positioning, driven by the keyboard as the WAI-ARIA menu button.

## Examples

The button opens the menu with the browser's command — `commandfor` names the menu, `command="toggle-popover"` opens and closes it — and the browser sets its `aria-expanded`. No script is needed to open a menu; the library adds the arrow keys.

```html
<button class="btn" type="button" commandfor="menu-actions-list" command="toggle-popover" aria-haspopup="menu"><i class="bi bi-three-dots" aria-hidden="true"></i>Actions</button>
<div id="menu-actions-list" class="menu" popover role="menu" aria-label="Actions">
	<button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitem"><i class="bi bi-pencil" aria-hidden="true"></i>Edit</button>
	<button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitem"><i class="bi bi-files" aria-hidden="true"></i>Duplicate</button>
	<button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitem" aria-disabled="true"><i class="bi bi-archive" aria-hidden="true"></i>Archive</button>
	<a class="menu-item" href="#menu-actions" role="menuitem"><i class="bi bi-box-arrow-up-right" aria-hidden="true"></i>Open on the site</a>
	<hr class="menu-divider">
	<button class="menu-item menu-item-danger" type="button" role="menuitem"><i class="bi bi-trash3" aria-hidden="true"></i>Delete</button>
</div>
```

### Choices and headers

A choice of one is a set of `menuitemradio` items, the chosen one `aria-checked="true"` with a check drawn after it. `menu-header` titles a part of the menu. `menu-start` lines the menu up with its button's start edge instead of its end.

```html
<button class="btn btn-text" type="button" commandfor="menu-choice-list" command="toggle-popover" aria-haspopup="menu"><span class="dot dot-success"></span>All sites<i class="bi bi-chevron-down" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
<div id="menu-choice-list" class="menu menu-start" popover role="menu" aria-label="Work context">
	<div class="menu-header">Work context</div>
	<button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitemradio" aria-checked="true"><i class="bi bi-grid-3x3-gap" aria-hidden="true"></i>All sites</button>
	<button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitemradio" aria-checked="false"><i class="bi bi-globe2" aria-hidden="true"></i>lagoon.example</button>
	<button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitemradio" aria-checked="false"><i class="bi bi-globe2" aria-hidden="true"></i>angthong.example</button>
</div>
```

## States

The items of an open menu. `:focus-visible` is where the arrow keys are; `aria-current="true"` marks the page a menu of links is on.

## Keyboard and accessibility

| Key | On the button | In the menu |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Enter`, `Space` | Opens the menu, the focus on the checked or the first item | Runs the item and closes the menu |
| `↓` / `↑` | Opens the menu on the first / the last item | The next / the previous item, round the ends |
| `Home` / `End` | — | The first / the last item |
| A letter | — | The next item that begins with it |
| `Esc` | — | Closes the menu, the focus back on the button |
| `Tab` | — | Closes the menu and moves on |

- The menu is `popover` with `role="menu"` and a name; its items are `menuitem`, `menuitemradio` or `menuitemcheckbox`. A list of site sections is navigation, not a menu — use links.
- The button carries `aria-haspopup="menu"`; the browser keeps its `aria-expanded`, moves the focus back to it on close and closes the menu on a click outside or `Esc`.
- Where an engine does not put the menu beside its button — no anchor positioning below Firefox 147 and Safari 26, no anchor from a popover's button in Chrome 130–132, a table cell in Chrome 135–136, the bottom of a long page in Safari 26 — `js/menu-place.js` places it, and the probes record each such place.

## Tokens

From [`css/components/menu.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/menu.css), which declares no custom property of its own.

It reads the theme's `--redz-space-4`, `--redz-border`, `--redz-radius-12`, `--redz-bg-raised`, `--redz-shadow-2`, `--redz-text`, `--redz-space-8`, `--redz-text-muted`, `--redz-fs-12`, `--redz-control-height`, `--redz-radius-8`, `--redz-bg-hover`, `--redz-primary`, `--redz-danger`, `--redz-motion`, `--redz-ease`.

## From Bootstrap 5.3

| Bootstrap 5.3 | REDZ.UI | Change | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `dropdown` | — | remove | no wrapper: the menu flips by itself |
| `dropdown-center` | — | remove | no wrapper: the menu flips by itself |
| `dropdown-divider` | `menu-divider` | rename |  |
| `dropdown-header` | `menu-header` | rename |  |
| `dropdown-item` | `menu-item` | rename | role="menuitem" |
| `dropdown-item-text` | — | review | menu-header, or plain text |
| `dropdown-menu` | `menu` | rename | with popover and role="menu" |
| `dropdown-menu-dark` | — | remove | the theme sets it |
| `dropdown-menu-end` | — | remove | the menu meets its button's end edge by default |
| `dropdown-menu-start` | `menu-start` | rename |  |
| `dropdown-toggle` | — | review | the button: commandfor + command="toggle-popover" + aria-haspopup="menu"; a chevron is an icon |
| `dropdown-toggle-split` | — | review | a btn-group of the action and a btn-icon that opens the menu |
| `dropend` | — | remove | no wrapper: the menu flips by itself |
| `dropstart` | — | remove | no wrapper: the menu flips by itself |
| `dropup` | — | remove | no wrapper: the menu flips by itself |
| `dropup-center` | — | remove | no wrapper: the menu flips by itself |
| `data-bs-toggle="dropdown"` | `commandfor="ID" command="toggle-popover" aria-haspopup="menu"` | trigger | the menu gets popover and role="menu" |
| `data-bs-placement` | — | remove | anchor positioning places and flips the menu |
| `data-bs-offset` | — | remove | anchor positioning places and flips the menu |
| `data-bs-auto-close` | — | remove | anchor positioning places and flips the menu |
| `data-bs-display` | — | remove | anchor positioning places and flips the menu |
| `data-bs-reference` | — | remove | anchor positioning places and flips the menu |
| `data-bs-boundary` | — | remove | anchor positioning places and flips the menu |
| `data-bs-popper-config` | — | remove | anchor positioning places and flips the menu |
| `bootstrap.Dropdown` | `menu.showPopover(), menu.hidePopover(), menu.togglePopover()` | trigger |  |
| `show.bs.dropdown` | `toggle` | rename | the popover's toggle event; event.newState is "open" or "closed" |
| `shown.bs.dropdown` | `toggle` | rename | the popover's toggle event; event.newState is "open" or "closed" |
| `hide.bs.dropdown` | `toggle` | rename | the popover's toggle event; event.newState is "open" or "closed" |
| `hidden.bs.dropdown` | `toggle` | rename | the popover's toggle event; event.newState is "open" or "closed" |

# Form fields

Text fields, selects and text areas with Bootstrap 5's names: a label floating in the field or above it, a hint, an error said in words, an icon inside the field.

## Examples

`form-floating` keeps the label inside the field and lifts it when the field has a value or the focus. The label follows the control, and the control needs a `placeholder` — it is how CSS knows the field is empty.

```html
<div class="form-floating">
	<input class="form-control" id="form-floating-name" value="Ang Thong: marine park by speedboat" placeholder="A name people search for">
	<label for="form-floating-name">Name</label>
</div>
<div class="form-floating">
	<input class="form-control" id="form-floating-mail" type="email" placeholder="name@example.com">
	<label for="form-floating-mail">E-mail</label>
</div>
<div class="form-floating">
	<select class="form-select" id="form-floating-section"><option>Marine</option><option>Land</option><option>Evening</option></select>
	<label for="form-floating-section">Section</label>
</div>
<div class="form-floating">
	<textarea class="form-control" id="form-floating-note" placeholder="A note for the guides">Pick up at the pier at 8:30.</textarea>
	<label for="form-floating-note">Note</label>
</div>
```

### A label above, a hint, an error

`form-field` stacks a field's parts: `form-label`, the control, `form-text` for a hint and `invalid-feedback` for an error. The control points at both with `aria-describedby`; an error sets `aria-invalid="true"`, and the browser's own `:user-invalid` draws the same after the person has edited the field.

```html
<div class="form-field">
	<label class="form-label" for="form-stacked-slug">Address</label>
	<input class="form-control font-monospace" id="form-stacked-slug" value="ang-thong" aria-describedby="form-stacked-slug-hint">
	<div class="form-text" id="form-stacked-slug-hint">Full address /excursions/ang-thong/. The old one answers with a 301 redirect.</div>
</div>
<div class="form-field">
	<label class="form-label" for="form-stacked-price">Adult price, THB</label>
	<input class="form-control tabular-nums" id="form-stacked-price" type="number" value="2500" min="0" step="100" aria-invalid="true" aria-describedby="form-stacked-price-error">
	<div class="invalid-feedback" id="form-stacked-price-error"><i class="bi bi-exclamation-triangle-fill" aria-hidden="true"></i>Lower than the child price</div>
</div>
```

### An icon in the field

`form-adorn` puts an icon inside a field, at its start; the field keeps its own name.

```html
<div class="form-adorn">
	<i class="bi bi-search" aria-hidden="true"></i>
	<input class="form-control" type="search" placeholder="Name, slug or code" aria-label="Search excursions">
</div>
```

### Sizes

`form-control-sm` and `form-select-sm` are 28 px high, the default 32 px, `-lg` 40 px — the same heights as the buttons beside them.

```html
<input class="form-control form-control-sm" placeholder="Small" aria-label="Small field">
<input class="form-control" placeholder="Default" aria-label="Default field">
<input class="form-control form-control-lg" placeholder="Large" aria-label="Large field">
<select class="form-select form-select-sm" aria-label="Small select"><option>Small select</option></select>
```

## States

## Keyboard and accessibility

- Every control has a visible label: a `<label for>`, or `aria-label` only where the context says it all — a search field with its icon.
- A placeholder is never the label: it goes away as the person types. In `form-floating` the placeholder is only the empty marker.
- An error is said in words in `invalid-feedback`, joined to the control by `aria-describedby`; a color alone never tells it.
- The borders of fields and the focus ring are at least 3:1 against the page in both themes; the text 4.5:1.
- `form-select` paints its own chevron from the theme, mirrored right to left; a multiple select or one with `size` drops it.

## Tokens

From [`css/components/form.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/form.css), which declares no custom property of its own.

It reads the theme's `--redz-space-4`, `--redz-text`, `--redz-fs-12`, `--redz-text-muted`, `--redz-danger`, `--redz-control-height`, `--redz-space-12`, `--redz-border-strong`, `--redz-radius-8`, `--redz-bg`, `--redz-focus`, `--redz-space-8`, `--redz-form-select-chevron`, `--redz-bg-page`, `--redz-primary-subtle`, `--redz-control-height-sm`, `--redz-radius-6`, `--redz-control-height-lg`, `--redz-fs-16`, `--redz-control-height-float`, `--redz-fs-14`, `--redz-motion`, `--redz-ease`.

## From Bootstrap 5.3

| Bootstrap 5.3 | REDZ.UI | Change | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `col-form-label` | `form-label` | review | a form-label in a form-field |
| `form-control-color` | — | review | a native <input type="color"> in the module's CSS |
| `form-control-plaintext` | — | review | readonly on a form-control, or plain text |
| `form-range` | — | missing |  |
| `has-validation` | — | remove | fields have no success state |
| `input-group` | — | missing | the missing basics; an icon inside a field is form-adorn |
| `input-group-text` | — | missing | the missing basics; an icon inside a field is form-adorn |
| `invalid-tooltip` | `invalid-feedback` | review | the error under the field |
| `is-invalid` | — | state | aria-invalid="true" on the control |
| `is-valid` | — | remove | fields have no success state |
| `valid-feedback` | — | remove | fields have no success state |
| `valid-tooltip` | — | remove | fields have no success state |
| `was-validated` | — | state | the browser's :user-invalid shows after the person edits |

# Checks, radios and switches

The browser's own checkbox and radio, drawn by the library: `check`, `radio` and `switch` on the input itself, `form-check` on the label around it.

## Examples

The class goes on the `<input>`; the label wraps it, so a click anywhere on the words toggles it.

```html
<fieldset class="vstack gap-8">
	<legend class="form-label">Included</legend>
	<label class="form-check"><input class="check" type="checkbox" checked>Transfer</label>
	<label class="form-check"><input class="check" type="checkbox" checked>Lunch</label>
	<label class="form-check"><input class="check" type="checkbox">Kayaks</label>
</fieldset>
```

### Radios

Radios with one `name` are one choice; the arrow keys move it.

```html
<fieldset class="vstack gap-8">
	<legend class="form-label">Departure</legend>
	<label class="form-check"><input class="radio" type="radio" name="check-radios-time" checked>Morning, 8:30</label>
	<label class="form-check"><input class="radio" type="radio" name="check-radios-time">Noon, 12:00</label>
	<label class="form-check"><input class="radio" type="radio" name="check-radios-time">Sunset, 16:30</label>
</fieldset>
```

### Switches

A switch is a checkbox with `role="switch"`: on or off, applied at once. One that cannot change keeps its focus with `aria-disabled="true"` and says why in a hint.

```html
<label class="form-check"><input class="switch" type="checkbox" role="switch" checked>Show on the site</label>
<div class="vstack gap-4">
	<label class="form-check"><input class="switch" type="checkbox" role="switch" aria-disabled="true" aria-describedby="check-switches-why">Hide “Powered by REDZ CMS”</label>
	<div class="form-text" id="check-switches-why"><i class="bi bi-lock" aria-hidden="true"></i> Available with a partner license</div>
</div>
```

## States

A check with some of its items chosen is `indeterminate` — a property set from script, as there is no attribute for it.

## Keyboard and accessibility

- Space toggles a check or a switch; the arrow keys move the choice among radios of one `name`.
- A set of checks or radios sits in a `<fieldset>` whose `<legend>` names it.
- The marks are drawn from the browser's own `:checked` and `:indeterminate`, and keep showing in forced colors and in print.
- `aria-disabled="true"` keeps the control focusable and readable, so its hint can say why; the library ignores clicks and Space on it, as on a button so marked.

## Tokens

From [`css/components/check.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/check.css), which declares no custom property of its own.

It reads the theme's `--redz-border-strong`, `--redz-bg`, `--redz-primary-contrast`, `--redz-primary`, `--redz-focus`, `--redz-border`, `--redz-bg-page`, `--redz-bg-hover`, `--redz-motion`, `--redz-ease`.

## From Bootstrap 5.3

| Bootstrap 5.3 | REDZ.UI | Change | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `form-check-inline` | — | review | hstack gap-16 around the labels |
| `form-check-input` | — | review | check, radio or switch on the input, by its type |
| `form-check-label` | — | remove | the label is the form-check around the input |
| `form-check-reverse` | — | missing |  |
| `form-switch` | — | review | switch on the input, with role="switch" |

# Cards

A card is a bordered region of a screen: a header with its title and actions, a body, a footer. It is a region — the width prefixes inside it measure the card, not the window.

## Examples

A card that is a section of the screen is a `<section>` named by its heading. The header holds an icon, the title and whatever belongs to it; the footer holds the card's actions.

```html
<section class="card" aria-labelledby="card-basic-title">
	<div class="card-header"><i class="bi bi-cash-coin" aria-hidden="true"></i><h2 id="card-basic-title">Price</h2><span class="text-muted fs-12">in the base currency THB</span></div>
	<div class="card-body vstack gap-8">
		<p>Adults 2,500 · children 1,900 · under four free.</p>
		<p class="text-muted">The visitor's currency is an estimate.</p>
	</div>
	<div class="card-footer justify-content-end">
		<button class="btn" type="button">Cancel</button>
		<button class="btn btn-primary" type="button">Save</button>
	</div>
</section>
```

### Tabs on a card

A `nav` placed straight in the card lines up with the header's padding.

```html
<section class="card" aria-labelledby="card-tabs-title">
	<div class="card-header"><h2 id="card-tabs-title">Ang Thong</h2></div>
	<div class="nav nav-underline" role="tablist" aria-label="Ang Thong">
		<button class="nav-link" type="button" role="tab" id="card-tabs-1" aria-selected="true" aria-controls="card-tabs-panel-1">Details</button>
		<button class="nav-link" type="button" role="tab" id="card-tabs-2" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="card-tabs-panel-2">Prices</button>
	</div>
	<div class="card-body" id="card-tabs-panel-1" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="card-tabs-1" tabindex="0"><p>A day at sea: snorkelling at two reefs, lunch on the boat.</p></div>
	<div class="card-body" id="card-tabs-panel-2" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="card-tabs-2" tabindex="0" hidden><p>Adults 2,500 · children 1,900.</p></div>
</section>
```

### A grid of cards

The parent sets the grid; each card measures itself. Under 576 px of the region the cards stack.

```html
<div class="grid sm:cols-2 gap-16">
	<section class="card" aria-labelledby="card-grid-a"><div class="card-header"><h2 id="card-grid-a">Bookings</h2></div><div class="card-body"><p class="fs-24 fw-600 tabular-nums">128</p><p class="text-muted">this week</p></div></section>
	<section class="card" aria-labelledby="card-grid-b"><div class="card-header"><h2 id="card-grid-b">Revenue</h2></div><div class="card-body"><p class="fs-24 fw-600 tabular-nums">312,400 THB</p><p class="text-muted">this week</p></div></section>
</div>
```

## Accessibility

- A card that is a part of the page is a `<section>` with `aria-labelledby` pointing at its heading; a card in a list of cards is an `<article>` or a list item.
- A card has no outer margin: the gap between cards belongs to their parent.
- A card being refreshed in place turns busy with `REDZ.ui.busy(card, promise)` — see [Busy](busy.md).

## Tokens

From [`css/components/card.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/card.css), which declares no custom property of its own.

It reads the theme's `--redz-border`, `--redz-radius-12`, `--redz-bg`, `--redz-space-8`, `--redz-space-12`, `--redz-space-16`, `--redz-text-muted`.

## From Bootstrap 5.3

| Bootstrap 5.3 | REDZ.UI | Change | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `card-group` | — | review | grid with gap-16 |
| `card-header-pills` | — | review | a nav straight in the card |
| `card-header-tabs` | — | review | a nav straight in the card |
| `card-img` | — | missing |  |
| `card-img-bottom` | — | missing |  |
| `card-img-overlay` | — | missing |  |
| `card-img-top` | — | missing |  |
| `card-link` | — | review | a heading and paragraphs in card-body |
| `card-subtitle` | — | review | a heading and paragraphs in card-body |
| `card-text` | — | review | a heading and paragraphs in card-body |
| `card-title` | — | review | a heading and paragraphs in card-body |

# Tables

A list of records: a title that links to the record, a line under it, a note when something is wrong, a column of checks for batch actions and the row's own actions at the end.

## Examples

`table` on the `<table>`; `table-hover` lights the row under the pointer. The head stays at the top of the screen as the page scrolls. Columns that only help on a wide screen hide below `md` of their card.

```html
<section class="card" aria-labelledby="table-list-title">
	<div class="card-header"><h2 id="table-list-title">Excursions</h2><span class="text-muted fs-12">3 of 28</span></div>
	<div class="card-body p-0">
		<table class="table table-hover">
			<thead>
				<tr>
					<th class="table-check"><input class="check" type="checkbox" aria-label="Select all"></th>
					<th>Excursion</th>
					<th class="text-end d-none md:d-table-cell">Price from</th>
					<th class="d-none md:d-table-cell">Status</th>
					<th class="table-actions"><span class="visually-hidden">Actions</span></th>
				</tr>
			</thead>
			<tbody>
				<tr>
					<td><input class="check" type="checkbox" aria-label="Select: Ang Thong"></td>
					<td><a class="table-title" href="#table-list">Ang Thong: marine park by speedboat</a><div class="table-sub d-none md:d-block">/excursions/ang-thong/</div></td>
					<td class="text-end tabular-nums text-nowrap d-none md:d-table-cell">2,500 THB</td>
					<td class="d-none md:d-table-cell"><span class="badge"><i class="bi bi-check2" aria-hidden="true"></i>Published</span></td>
					<td class="table-actions"><button class="btn btn-sm btn-icon btn-text" type="button" aria-label="Edit: Ang Thong"><i class="bi bi-pencil" aria-hidden="true"></i></button></td>
				</tr>
				<tr class="table-danger">
					<td><input class="check" type="checkbox" aria-label="Select: Elephant sanctuary"></td>
					<td><a class="table-title" href="#table-list">Elephant sanctuary: feeding and a walk</a><div class="table-note"><i class="bi bi-x-octagon-fill" aria-hidden="true"></i><span class="text-muted">Did not rebuild: a PHP warning in the theme template</span></div></td>
					<td class="text-end tabular-nums text-nowrap d-none md:d-table-cell">2,600 THB</td>
					<td class="d-none md:d-table-cell"><span class="badge badge-subtle-danger"><i class="bi bi-x-octagon" aria-hidden="true"></i>Failed</span></td>
					<td class="table-actions"><button class="btn btn-sm btn-icon btn-text" type="button" aria-label="Rebuild: Elephant sanctuary"><i class="bi bi-arrow-repeat" aria-hidden="true"></i></button></td>
				</tr>
				<tr class="table-warning">
					<td><input class="check" type="checkbox" aria-label="Select: Night market"></td>
					<td><a class="table-title" href="#table-list">Night market and street food</a><div class="table-note"><i class="bi bi-exclamation-triangle-fill" aria-hidden="true"></i><span class="text-muted">The Thai translation is older than the English</span></div></td>
					<td class="text-end tabular-nums text-nowrap d-none md:d-table-cell">900 THB</td>
					<td class="d-none md:d-table-cell"><span class="badge badge-subtle-warning"><i class="bi bi-clock-history" aria-hidden="true"></i>Stale</span></td>
					<td class="table-actions"><button class="btn btn-sm btn-icon btn-text" type="button" aria-label="Edit: Night market"><i class="bi bi-pencil" aria-hidden="true"></i></button></td>
				</tr>
				<tr class="table-secondary">
					<td><input class="check" type="checkbox" aria-label="Select: Muay Thai"></td>
					<td><a class="table-title" href="#table-list">Muay Thai: an evening at the stadium</a><div class="table-sub d-none md:d-block">withdrawn from the sites</div></td>
					<td class="text-end tabular-nums text-nowrap d-none md:d-table-cell">1,500 THB</td>
					<td class="d-none md:d-table-cell"><span class="badge"><i class="bi bi-eye-slash" aria-hidden="true"></i>Withdrawn</span></td>
					<td class="table-actions"><button class="btn btn-sm btn-icon btn-text" type="button" aria-label="Edit: Muay Thai"><i class="bi bi-pencil" aria-hidden="true"></i></button></td>
				</tr>
			</tbody>
		</table>
	</div>
</section>
```

## States

A row's tone marks what needs attention: `table-danger` failed, `table-warning` needs a look, `table-secondary` is out of use. On a pointer screen the row's actions show on hover and on focus; on a touch screen they always show.

## Keyboard and accessibility

- The row's title is a link; its actions are buttons named with the record — "Edit: Ang Thong", not a column of identical "Edit".
- The column of actions has a hidden header, and each check its own name: "Select: Ang Thong".
- A tone is never the only sign: a failed row also says why in its `table-note`, with an icon.
- Numbers sit at the end of their cells with `tabular-nums`, so their digits line up.
- A table being reloaded turns busy on its card's body: `REDZ.ui.busy(body, promise)` — not on the `<table>`, which cannot hold an overlay.

## Tokens

From [`css/components/table.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/table.css). It declares `--redz-row-tint`, `--redz-row-mark` on its root, never on rows or items.

It reads the theme's `--redz-space-8`, `--redz-space-12`, `--redz-border`, `--redz-bg`, `--redz-text-muted`, `--redz-fs-12`, `--redz-row-pad`, `--redz-radius-12`, `--redz-space-16`, `--redz-bg-hover`, `--redz-text`, `--redz-font-mono`, `--redz-space-4`, `--redz-danger-subtle`, `--redz-danger`, `--redz-warning-subtle`, `--redz-warning`, `--redz-bg-page`.

## From Bootstrap 5.3

| Bootstrap 5.3 | REDZ.UI | Change | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `caption-top` | — | missing |  |
| `table-active` | — | review | aria-selected or aria-current on the row |
| `table-bordered` | — | missing |  |
| `table-borderless` | — | missing |  |
| `table-dark` | — | review | row tones are danger, warning and secondary |
| `table-group-divider` | — | missing |  |
| `table-info` | — | review | row tones are danger, warning and secondary |
| `table-light` | — | review | row tones are danger, warning and secondary |
| `table-primary` | — | review | row tones are danger, warning and secondary |
| `table-responsive` | — | review | the card's body holds the table; columns hide below md: |
| `table-striped` | — | missing |  |
| `table-striped-columns` | — | missing |  |
| `table-success` | — | review | row tones are danger, warning and secondary |

# Badges

A badge is a short label of state or count beside the thing it describes: Published, Draft, 5 new. It never acts — a badge that does something is a chip or a button.

## Examples

The plain `badge` is neutral, for a status that needs no attention. `badge-subtle-{tone}` is the usual colored form; `badge-{tone}`, filled, is for the one that must be seen. An icon before the words carries the meaning in forced colors and for people who do not tell the colors apart.

```html
<span class="badge"><i class="bi bi-check2" aria-hidden="true"></i>Published</span>
<span class="badge"><i class="bi bi-pencil-square" aria-hidden="true"></i>Draft</span>
<span class="badge badge-subtle-success"><i class="bi bi-check-circle" aria-hidden="true"></i>Paid</span>
<span class="badge badge-subtle-warning"><i class="bi bi-clock-history" aria-hidden="true"></i>Stale</span>
<span class="badge badge-subtle-danger"><i class="bi bi-x-octagon" aria-hidden="true"></i>Failed</span>
<span class="badge badge-subtle-info"><i class="bi bi-robot" aria-hidden="true"></i>Machine translation</span>
<span class="badge badge-subtle-primary">New</span>
<span class="badge badge-subtle-secondary">Archived</span>
```

### Filled

```html
<span class="badge badge-primary">5</span>
<span class="badge badge-secondary">Beta</span>
<span class="badge badge-success">Live</span>
<span class="badge badge-danger">Overdue</span>
<span class="badge badge-warning">Due today</span>
<span class="badge badge-info">Update</span>
```

### Beside other things

A count in a navigation link, a status in a heading.

```html
<nav class="nav nav-pills" aria-label="Orders">
	<a class="nav-link" href="#badge-beside" aria-current="page">New<span class="badge badge-subtle-primary">5</span></a>
	<a class="nav-link" href="#badge-beside">Paid<span class="badge">128</span></a>
</nav>
<h3 class="hstack gap-8 fs-16">Ang Thong <span class="badge badge-subtle-warning"><i class="bi bi-clock-history" aria-hidden="true"></i>Stale</span></h3>
```

## Accessibility

- A badge's words are read with the thing it stands beside; write them so — "5" in "New 5" reads as five new orders only if the link says New.
- The tones of text against their fill are at least 4.5:1 in both themes; a tone alone is never the meaning.

## Tokens

From [`css/components/badge.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/badge.css). It declares `--redz-badge-bg`, `--redz-badge-fg` on its root, never on rows or items.

It reads the theme's `--redz-bg-hover`, `--redz-text-muted`, `--redz-fs-12`, `--redz-primary`, `--redz-primary-contrast`, `--redz-secondary`, `--redz-secondary-contrast`, `--redz-success`, `--redz-success-contrast`, `--redz-danger`, `--redz-danger-contrast`, `--redz-warning`, `--redz-warning-contrast`, `--redz-info`, `--redz-info-contrast`, `--redz-primary-subtle`, `--redz-secondary-subtle`, `--redz-success-subtle`, `--redz-danger-subtle`, `--redz-warning-subtle`, `--redz-info-subtle`.

## From Bootstrap 5.3

| Bootstrap 5.3 | REDZ.UI | Change | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text-bg-danger` | `badge-danger` | review | on a badge; elsewhere bg-$1 with the tone's -contrast text in the module's CSS |
| `text-bg-dark` | — | review | a plain badge, or a tone |
| `text-bg-info` | `badge-info` | review | on a badge; elsewhere bg-$1 with the tone's -contrast text in the module's CSS |
| `text-bg-light` | — | review | a plain badge, or a tone |
| `text-bg-primary` | `badge-primary` | review | on a badge; elsewhere bg-$1 with the tone's -contrast text in the module's CSS |
| `text-bg-secondary` | `badge-secondary` | review | on a badge; elsewhere bg-$1 with the tone's -contrast text in the module's CSS |
| `text-bg-success` | `badge-success` | review | on a badge; elsewhere bg-$1 with the tone's -contrast text in the module's CSS |
| `text-bg-warning` | `badge-warning` | review | on a badge; elsewhere bg-$1 with the tone's -contrast text in the module's CSS |

# Dots

An 8 px dot of a tone beside a word: online, live, the color of a site. The dot repeats what the word says; it never says it alone.

## Examples

```html
<span class="hstack gap-8"><span class="dot"></span>Offline</span>
<span class="hstack gap-8"><span class="dot dot-primary"></span>Primary</span>
<span class="hstack gap-8"><span class="dot dot-secondary"></span>Secondary</span>
<span class="hstack gap-8"><span class="dot dot-success"></span>Live</span>
<span class="hstack gap-8"><span class="dot dot-danger"></span>Down</span>
<span class="hstack gap-8"><span class="dot dot-warning"></span>Slow</span>
<span class="hstack gap-8"><span class="dot dot-info"></span>Updating</span>
```

## Accessibility

- A dot has no name; the word beside it carries the meaning. In forced colors every dot is drawn in the text color, so the word is what tells them apart.
- Dots print with their colors.

## Tokens

From [`css/components/dot.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/dot.css), which declares no custom property of its own.

It reads the theme's `--redz-text-faint`, `--redz-primary`, `--redz-secondary`, `--redz-success`, `--redz-danger`, `--redz-warning`, `--redz-info`.

# Avatars

A round mark of a person: their initials in the accent, 32 px or 24 px with `avatar-sm`.

## Examples

An avatar beside the person's name hides from assistive technology; an avatar alone — the profile button — is named by its button.

```html
<span class="hstack gap-8"><span class="avatar" aria-hidden="true">MK</span>Marina K.</span>
<span class="hstack gap-8"><span class="avatar avatar-sm" aria-hidden="true">AT</span>Arthit T.</span>
<button class="btn btn-text btn-icon" type="button" aria-label="MK, profile"><span class="avatar">MK</span></button>
```

## Accessibility

- The initials are 4.5:1 against the fill in both themes.
- Where a person's photo is wanted, put an `<img alt="">` inside the avatar; the name beside it carries the meaning.

## Tokens

From [`css/components/avatar.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/avatar.css), which declares no custom property of its own.

It reads the theme's `--redz-primary-subtle`, `--redz-primary`, `--redz-fs-12`.

# Icon tiles

A rounded square with an icon in it: the mark of a screen's subject in its title, of a kind of record, of a drop zone.

## Examples

The plain tile is in the accent; the tones and `icon-tile-sm` follow Bootstrap's grammar.

```html
<span class="icon-tile"><i class="bi bi-compass" aria-hidden="true"></i></span>
<span class="icon-tile icon-tile-secondary"><i class="bi bi-archive" aria-hidden="true"></i></span>
<span class="icon-tile icon-tile-success"><i class="bi bi-check-circle" aria-hidden="true"></i></span>
<span class="icon-tile icon-tile-danger"><i class="bi bi-x-octagon" aria-hidden="true"></i></span>
<span class="icon-tile icon-tile-warning"><i class="bi bi-exclamation-triangle" aria-hidden="true"></i></span>
<span class="icon-tile icon-tile-info"><i class="bi bi-info-circle" aria-hidden="true"></i></span>
<span class="icon-tile icon-tile-sm"><i class="bi bi-upload" aria-hidden="true"></i></span>
```

### In a title

```html
<div class="hstack gap-12">
	<span class="icon-tile"><i class="bi bi-compass" aria-hidden="true"></i></span>
	<div><h3 class="fs-20">Excursions</h3><p class="text-muted">Content type · 28 items</p></div>
</div>
```

## Accessibility

- The tile is decoration: its icon is `aria-hidden="true"` and the words beside it name the subject.
- The icon keeps a 3:1 contrast with its tile in both themes.

## Tokens

From [`css/components/icon-tile.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/icon-tile.css). It declares `--redz-tile-bg`, `--redz-tile-fg` on its root, never on rows or items.

It reads the theme's `--redz-primary-subtle`, `--redz-primary`, `--redz-radius-12`, `--redz-radius-8`, `--redz-secondary-subtle`, `--redz-secondary`, `--redz-success-subtle`, `--redz-success`, `--redz-danger-subtle`, `--redz-danger`, `--redz-warning-subtle`, `--redz-warning`, `--redz-info-subtle`, `--redz-info`.

# Empty states

What a list, a panel or a search shows when it has nothing yet: what would be here, and the one action that starts it. And the drop zone of a file field.

## Examples

```html
<div class="empty-state">
	<i class="bi bi-compass" aria-hidden="true"></i>
	<strong class="text-body">No excursions yet</strong>
	<p>An excursion is a page with a price, a schedule and a booking form.</p>
	<button class="btn btn-primary" type="button"><i class="bi bi-plus-lg" aria-hidden="true"></i>New excursion</button>
</div>
```

### A drop zone

`empty-state-drop` is a label around a hidden file input: a click or a dropped file goes to the input.

```html
<label class="empty-state empty-state-drop">
	<span class="icon-tile icon-tile-sm"><i class="bi bi-upload" aria-hidden="true"></i></span>
	<span class="vstack gap-2"><strong class="text-body">Logo · light theme</strong><span class="form-text">SVG or PNG, drop a file or choose</span></span>
	<input class="visually-hidden" type="file" accept="image/svg+xml,image/png">
</label>
```

## States

## Accessibility

- Say what would be here and why it is empty — "No excursions yet", "Nothing matches the filters" — and offer the action that changes it.
- The drop zone's file input is hidden visually only; its label is the zone's words, and the focus ring shows on the zone through the label.

## Tokens

From [`css/components/empty-state.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/empty-state.css), which declares no custom property of its own.

It reads the theme's `--redz-space-8`, `--redz-space-32`, `--redz-space-16`, `--redz-text-muted`, `--redz-text-faint`, `--redz-space-12`, `--redz-border-strong`, `--redz-radius-12`, `--redz-primary`, `--redz-primary-subtle`.

# Placeholders

Grey bars in the shape of content that is on its way — the first load of a page or a panel. A region that already has content and reloads it gets an overlay instead: see [Busy](busy.md).

## Examples

Each bar is a `placeholder` sized by a width utility. They pulse slowly, and stand still for people who ask for less motion.

```html
<section class="card" aria-label="Loading">
	<div class="card-header"><span class="placeholder w-25"></span></div>
	<div class="card-body vstack gap-8">
		<span class="placeholder w-75"></span>
		<span class="placeholder w-50"></span>
		<span class="placeholder w-100"></span>
	</div>
</section>
```

## Accessibility

- Placeholders are empty elements; the region holding them is named "Loading" until the content takes its place.
- Keep the shapes close to the real content, so the page does not jump when it arrives.

## Tokens

From [`css/components/placeholder.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/placeholder.css), which declares no custom property of its own.

It reads the theme's `--redz-radius-6`, `--redz-border`.

## From Bootstrap 5.3

| Bootstrap 5.3 | REDZ.UI | Change | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `placeholder-glow` | — | remove | placeholders pulse by themselves |
| `placeholder-wave` | — | remove | placeholders pulse by themselves |
| `placeholder-xs` | — | review | size by the height of the bar |

# Dialogs

The browser's own modal `<dialog>`: opened by a command, the page behind it inert and dimmed, closed by its buttons, `Esc` or a click outside. And `REDZ.ui.confirm()` for a question asked from script.

## Examples

A button opens the dialog with `commandfor` + `command="show-modal"`; buttons inside close it with `command="close"`. `closedby="any"` lets a click outside close it too. The focus goes into the dialog — to the control marked `autofocus` — and back to the button when it closes.

```html
<button class="btn" type="button" commandfor="dialog-edit-note" command="show-modal"><i class="bi bi-chat-left-text" aria-hidden="true"></i>Add a note</button>
<dialog id="dialog-edit-note" class="dialog" closedby="any" aria-labelledby="dialog-edit-note-title">
	<div class="dialog-header">
		<h2 class="dialog-title" id="dialog-edit-note-title">A note for the guides</h2>
		<button class="btn-close" type="button" commandfor="dialog-edit-note" command="close" aria-label="Close"></button>
	</div>
	<div class="dialog-body vstack gap-8">
		<label class="form-field"><span class="form-label">Note</span><textarea class="form-control" autofocus>Pick up at the pier at 8:30.</textarea></label>
	</div>
	<div class="dialog-footer">
		<button class="btn" type="button" commandfor="dialog-edit-note" command="close">Cancel</button>
		<button class="btn btn-primary" type="button" commandfor="dialog-edit-note" command="close">Save</button>
	</div>
</dialog>
```

### Sizes

`dialog-sm` for a question, the default for a form, `dialog-lg` for a wide table or a preview.

```html
<button class="btn" type="button" commandfor="dialog-sizes-sm" command="show-modal">Small</button>
<button class="btn" type="button" commandfor="dialog-sizes-lg" command="show-modal">Large</button>
<dialog id="dialog-sizes-sm" class="dialog dialog-sm" aria-labelledby="dialog-sizes-sm-title">
	<div class="dialog-header"><h2 class="dialog-title" id="dialog-sizes-sm-title">Publish now?</h2></div>
	<div class="dialog-body"><p>The page goes live on three sites.</p></div>
	<div class="dialog-footer">
		<button class="btn" type="button" commandfor="dialog-sizes-sm" command="close" autofocus>Cancel</button>
		<button class="btn btn-primary" type="button" commandfor="dialog-sizes-sm" command="close">Publish</button>
	</div>
</dialog>
<dialog id="dialog-sizes-lg" class="dialog dialog-lg" closedby="any" aria-labelledby="dialog-sizes-lg-title">
	<div class="dialog-header">
		<h2 class="dialog-title" id="dialog-sizes-lg-title">History of changes</h2>
		<button class="btn-close" type="button" commandfor="dialog-sizes-lg" command="close" aria-label="Close"></button>
	</div>
	<div class="dialog-body"><p>Edited yesterday by M. K.; published on three sites; the Thai translation updated today.</p></div>
</dialog>
```

### A confirmation from script

`await REDZ.ui.confirm({title, text, ok, tone})` builds an `alertdialog`, waits for the answer and removes it: `true` for the confirming button, `false` for Cancel, `Esc` or a click outside. The focus starts on Cancel; the button words come from the caller or the page's texts.

```html
<button class="btn btn-danger" type="button" data-docs-run="confirm"><i class="bi bi-trash3" aria-hidden="true"></i>Delete 2 excursions</button>
<span class="text-muted fs-12" role="status" data-docs-answer></span>
```

## Keyboard and accessibility

- `Tab` stays inside an open dialog; `Esc` closes it; the focus goes back to the button that opened it.
- The dialog is named by its title through `aria-labelledby`. A question that must be answered is `role="alertdialog"` with its focus on the safe answer.
- The page behind does not scroll while a dialog is open, and keeps its width: the scrollbar's place stays.
- A notice raised while a dialog is open shows inside the dialog, since everything outside it is inert.
- Where the browser lacks invoker commands (below Chrome 135, Firefox 144, Safari 26.2) or `closedby` (below Chrome 134, Firefox 141, and in Safari), the library's script stands in.

## Tokens

From [`css/components/dialog.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/dialog.css), which declares no custom property of its own.

It reads the theme's `--redz-border`, `--redz-radius-16`, `--redz-bg-raised`, `--redz-shadow-3`, `--redz-space-12`, `--redz-space-16`, `--redz-space-24`, `--redz-fs-16`, `--redz-text-muted`, `--redz-space-8`, `--redz-bg-page`, `--redz-ease`.

## From Bootstrap 5.3

| Bootstrap 5.3 | REDZ.UI | Change | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `modal` | `dialog` | rename | on a <dialog>, opened by commandfor + command="show-modal" |
| `modal-backdrop` | — | remove | the browser's ::backdrop |
| `modal-body` | `dialog-body` | rename |  |
| `modal-content` | — | remove | no wrappers: the <dialog> is the box |
| `modal-dialog` | — | remove | no wrappers: the <dialog> is the box |
| `modal-dialog-centered` | — | remove | a dialog is centered |
| `modal-dialog-scrollable` | — | remove | the dialog's body scrolls by itself |
| `modal-footer` | `dialog-footer` | rename |  |
| `modal-fullscreen` | — | missing |  |
| `modal-header` | `dialog-header` | rename |  |
| `modal-static` | — | remove | closedby="closerequest" |
| `modal-title` | `dialog-title` | rename |  |
| `data-bs-toggle="modal"` | `commandfor="ID" command="show-modal"` | trigger | on the button; the dialog is a <dialog id="ID"> |
| `data-bs-dismiss="modal"` | `commandfor="ID" command="close"` | trigger |  |
| `data-bs-backdrop="static"` | `closedby="closerequest"` | trigger | Esc closes it, a click outside does not |
| `data-bs-keyboard="false"` | `closedby="none"` | trigger | only its buttons close it |
| `bootstrap.Modal` | `dialog.showModal() and dialog.close()` | trigger |  |
| `show.bs.modal` | `toggle` | review | the dialog's toggle event, or code right after showModal() |
| `shown.bs.modal` | `toggle` | review | the dialog's toggle event, or code right after showModal() |
| `hide.bs.modal` | `cancel` | review | the dialog's cancel event (Esc); your buttons close it |
| `hidden.bs.modal` | `close` | rename | the dialog's close event; dialog.returnValue holds the closing button's value |

# Drawers

A modal panel at the end of the screen — or at its start with `drawer-start` — for filters, a record's details, a long form beside the list it belongs to. Bootstrap 5 calls it offcanvas; it is a `<dialog>` here.

## Examples

A drawer opens and closes like a dialog: `command="show-modal"` and `command="close"`. It slides in from its side — mirrored right to left — unless the person asks for less motion.

```html
<button class="btn" type="button" commandfor="drawer-filters-panel" command="show-modal"><i class="bi bi-funnel" aria-hidden="true"></i>Filters</button>
<button class="btn" type="button" commandfor="drawer-filters-start" command="show-modal"><i class="bi bi-layout-sidebar" aria-hidden="true"></i>From the start</button>
<dialog id="drawer-filters-panel" class="drawer" closedby="any" aria-labelledby="drawer-filters-panel-title">
	<div class="drawer-header">
		<h2 class="drawer-title" id="drawer-filters-panel-title">Filters</h2>
		<button class="btn-close" type="button" commandfor="drawer-filters-panel" command="close" aria-label="Close"></button>
	</div>
	<div class="drawer-body vstack gap-16">
		<fieldset class="vstack gap-8">
			<legend class="form-label">Status</legend>
			<label class="form-check"><input class="check" type="checkbox" checked>Published</label>
			<label class="form-check"><input class="check" type="checkbox">Draft</label>
		</fieldset>
		<div class="form-floating">
			<select class="form-select" id="drawer-filters-section"><option>Any section</option><option>Marine</option><option>Land</option></select>
			<label for="drawer-filters-section">Section</label>
		</div>
		<div class="hstack gap-8 justify-content-end">
			<button class="btn" type="button" commandfor="drawer-filters-panel" command="close">Reset</button>
			<button class="btn btn-primary" type="button" commandfor="drawer-filters-panel" command="close">Show 9</button>
		</div>
	</div>
</dialog>
<dialog id="drawer-filters-start" class="drawer drawer-start" closedby="any" aria-labelledby="drawer-filters-start-title">
	<div class="drawer-header">
		<h2 class="drawer-title" id="drawer-filters-start-title">Sections</h2>
		<button class="btn-close" type="button" commandfor="drawer-filters-start" command="close" aria-label="Close"></button>
	</div>
	<div class="drawer-body"><p>A drawer at the start edge: the left in English, the right in Arabic.</p></div>
</dialog>
```

## Keyboard and accessibility

- Everything said of [dialogs](dialog.md) holds: the focus moves in and back, `Tab` stays inside, `Esc` closes.
- A drawer is a region: the width prefixes inside it measure the drawer, 28 rem wide at most.
- The drawer's body scrolls by itself; its header stays.

## Tokens

From [`css/components/drawer.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/drawer.css), which declares no custom property of its own.

It reads the theme's `--redz-space-8`, `--redz-border`, `--redz-radius-12`, `--redz-bg-raised`, `--redz-shadow-3`, `--redz-space-12`, `--redz-space-16`, `--redz-fs-16`, `--redz-ease`.

## From Bootstrap 5.3

| Bootstrap 5.3 | REDZ.UI | Change | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `offcanvas` | `drawer` | rename | on a <dialog>, opened by command="show-modal" |
| `offcanvas-backdrop` | — | remove | the browser's ::backdrop |
| `offcanvas-body` | `drawer-body` | rename |  |
| `offcanvas-bottom` | — | missing |  |
| `offcanvas-end` | `drawer` | rename | on a <dialog>, opened by command="show-modal" |
| `offcanvas-header` | `drawer-header` | rename |  |
| `offcanvas-start` | `drawer drawer-start` | rename |  |
| `offcanvas-title` | `drawer-title` | rename |  |
| `offcanvas-top` | — | missing |  |
| `data-bs-toggle="offcanvas"` | `commandfor="ID" command="show-modal"` | trigger | the drawer is a <dialog id="ID"> |
| `data-bs-dismiss="offcanvas"` | `commandfor="ID" command="close"` | trigger |  |
| `bootstrap.Offcanvas` | `dialog.showModal() and dialog.close()` | trigger |  |

# Tooltips

A short dark label beside a control, placed by CSS anchor positioning. At the browser floor it is a toggletip: a small button opens it, a click outside or `Esc` closes it.

## Examples

The tooltip is a `popover` opened by its button's command. It sits above the button and turns below when there is no room — `js/menu-place.js` keeps it beside its button where an engine cannot.

```html
<span class="hstack gap-4">Partner license
	<button class="btn btn-icon btn-xs btn-text" type="button" commandfor="tooltip-why-tip" command="toggle-popover" aria-label="What is a partner license"><i class="bi bi-question-circle" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>
</span>
<div id="tooltip-why-tip" class="tooltip" popover role="tooltip">A partner can hide the brand and set their own help link.</div>
```

## Keyboard and accessibility

- The button is named after its question; the tooltip's words answer it. Nothing that must be read to use the screen lives only in a tooltip.
- A tooltip on hover and focus waits for `interestfor`, which is outside the browser floor.
- The label is the page's text color on the page color reversed: 4.5:1 in both themes, an outline in forced colors.

## Tokens

From [`css/components/tooltip.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/tooltip.css), which declares no custom property of its own.

It reads the theme's `--redz-space-4`, `--redz-space-8`, `--redz-radius-6`, `--redz-text`, `--redz-bg`, `--redz-fs-12`.

## From Bootstrap 5.3

| Bootstrap 5.3 | REDZ.UI | Change | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bs-popover-auto` | — | missing | a short note is a toggletip; a rich one a menu or a drawer |
| `bs-popover-bottom` | — | missing | a short note is a toggletip; a rich one a menu or a drawer |
| `bs-popover-end` | — | missing | a short note is a toggletip; a rich one a menu or a drawer |
| `bs-popover-start` | — | missing | a short note is a toggletip; a rich one a menu or a drawer |
| `bs-popover-top` | — | missing | a short note is a toggletip; a rich one a menu or a drawer |
| `bs-tooltip-auto` | — | remove | the tooltip is one element |
| `bs-tooltip-bottom` | — | remove | the tooltip is one element |
| `bs-tooltip-end` | — | remove | the tooltip is one element |
| `bs-tooltip-start` | — | remove | the tooltip is one element |
| `bs-tooltip-top` | — | remove | the tooltip is one element |
| `popover` | — | missing | a short note is a toggletip; a rich one a menu or a drawer |
| `popover-arrow` | — | missing | a short note is a toggletip; a rich one a menu or a drawer |
| `popover-body` | — | missing | a short note is a toggletip; a rich one a menu or a drawer |
| `popover-header` | — | missing | a short note is a toggletip; a rich one a menu or a drawer |
| `tooltip-arrow` | — | remove | the tooltip is one element |
| `tooltip-inner` | — | remove | the tooltip is one element |
| `data-bs-toggle="tooltip"` | `commandfor="ID" command="toggle-popover"` | review | a toggletip at the browser floor |
| `data-bs-toggle="popover"` | — | missing |  |
| `bootstrap.Tooltip` | — | remove |  |
| `bootstrap.Popover` | — | remove |  |

# Alerts

A message that stays on the page beside what it is about: a check passed, a suggestion, a warning before an action. A message that comes and goes is a [toast](toast.md).

## Examples

An icon, then the words in a `<div>`. The plain `alert` is neutral; the tones follow Bootstrap's.

```html
<div class="alert"><i class="bi bi-info-circle" aria-hidden="true"></i><div>The changes apply to the next booking.</div></div>
<div class="alert alert-primary"><i class="bi bi-stars" aria-hidden="true"></i><div>A shorter title would fit the search results.</div></div>
<div class="alert alert-success"><i class="bi bi-check-circle" aria-hidden="true"></i><div>White text on it: 5.6:1, AA in both themes.</div></div>
<div class="alert alert-warning"><i class="bi bi-exclamation-triangle" aria-hidden="true"></i><div>The Thai translation is older than the English.</div></div>
<div class="alert alert-danger"><i class="bi bi-x-octagon" aria-hidden="true"></i><div>The theme template raised a PHP warning; the page did not rebuild.</div></div>
<div class="alert alert-info"><i class="bi bi-robot" aria-hidden="true"></i><div>Translated by machine; a person has not read it yet.</div></div>
```

### With a title and actions

```html
<div class="alert alert-primary align-items-start" role="region" aria-label="AI suggestion">
	<i class="bi bi-stars" aria-hidden="true"></i>
	<div class="vstack gap-8">
		<strong>A shorter title</strong>
		<p>“Ang Thong by speedboat” fits the 60 characters search results show.</p>
		<div class="hstack gap-8"><button class="btn btn-sm btn-primary" type="button">Use it</button><button class="btn btn-sm btn-text" type="button">Dismiss</button></div>
	</div>
</div>
```

## Accessibility

- An alert that is on the page from the start is plain content — no live region. One that appears after an action and must be heard goes in a live region, or is a toast.
- A suggestion with its own actions is a `region` named after what it is.
- The icon carries the tone in forced colors; the words carry the meaning.

## Tokens

From [`css/components/alert.css`](https://github.com/redz-tech/REDZ.UI/blob/main/css/components/alert.css). It declares `--redz-alert-bg`, `--redz-alert-icon` on its root, never on rows or items.
